name: Ayllusuchus
sum: Ayllusuchus is a medium-sized sebecid crocodyliform from the Eocene Lumbrera Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: Described as medium-sized; no length is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Gasparini in 1984.
material: Skull material from the Lumbrera Formation (Casamayoran).
biology: It had a relatively long, low snout compared with other sebecids.
author: Gasparini 1984
